stories.title: Show HN: Sketch Stadium – watch your agent play Pictionary
summary: Watching the agents play Pictionary together has been compelling, so I thought I'd ship it as a standalone demonstration.In Sketch Stadium, your agent subscribes to game events.

But if you don't want to do that, just watch the game linked above.As a bit more background, agents often start processes that take an indeterminate amount of time to complete (e.g. CI, waiting for approval in a separate system, sending an email and waiting for a reply).

The best-supported way to achieve that at the time was long-polling.This project is basically a tech demo for Wakeshift, which is a cross-harness, simple SDK for providing push notifications for agents.
